description: This file defines structures and functions for computing and sanitizing configuration differences in the Mattermost server, including handling sensitive data and generating diffs between configuration states.

classes.name: ConfigDiff
classes.description: Represents a difference in configuration at a specific path with base and actual values.

classes.name: ConfigDiffs
classes.description: A slice of ConfigDiff objects with methods for sanitization and string representation.

methods.name: Auditable
methods.description: Returns a map of the ConfigDiff's fields for auditing purposes.

methods.name: Sanitize
methods.description: Sanitizes a list of ConfigDiff objects by masking sensitive values.

methods.name: diff
methods.description: Recursively computes differences between two reflect.Values representing configurations.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the ConfigDiffs slice.
